Mali.title: Strikes against terrorists in Mali,...
Mali.summary: Strikes against terrorists in Mali, elimination of a terrorist base in Burkina Faso: summary of combat operations in the Sahel from 17 to 30 October In the second half of October, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), together with units of the Africa Corps of the Russian Ministry of Defence, continued the anti-terrorist operations against the terrorists of JNIM (affiliated with Al-Qaeda*) and the Liberation Front of azawad (Fla).

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the FANS: "Their supreme sacrifice is the sacred seed of our freedom", Captain Ibrahim Traoré pays tribute to the fallen soldiers
Burkina Faso.summary: On the occasion of the 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces, the President of Faso, Comrade Captain Ibrahim Traoré, saluted the commitment and sacrifice of the men and women who defend the Fatherland, this Sunday, November 1, 2026. In his message, he also highlighted the modernization of the army and the entry into force of the military reserve, placed at the heart of the sovereign defense of Burkina Faso .

Burkina Faso.title: SIAO 2026: Illegal sellers of entry tickets arrested, 160 tickets seized by the National Police
Burkina Faso.summary: SIAO 2026: Illegal sellers of entrance tickets arrested, 160 tickets seized by the National Police The National Police arrested several individuals involved in the illegal resale of entrance tickets at the 18th edition of the Ouagadougou International Crafts Fair (SIAO 2026). The operation, carried out at the event site, resulted in the seizure of 160 tickets with a nominal value of 500 and 1,000 FCFA .

Niger.title: Diplomacy: The Prime Minister of Niger on an official visit to Benghazi to strengthen bilateral cooperation
Niger.summary: Arriving this Sunday, November 1, 2026 in Benghazi, the Prime Minister of Niger is making an official visit to Libya. Welcomed by the President of the Libyan government, Dr. Oussama Hammad, the head of the Nigerien government is at the head of a large high-level delegation, marked by a strong presence of the military high command .

Niger.title: Niger: the Algerian army in Arlit, on its way to Madama
Niger.summary: A first convoy of the Algerian army arrived in Arlit, in northern Niger, before reaching Madama, a destination set by the Algerian Parliament. Deployed at the request of Niamey to protect common energy interests, the ANP is located in the heart of a space where Kafra oil and the future trans-Saharan gas pipeline are played out.

Niger.title: Niger: the army announces the neutralization of seven individuals presented as mercenaries and armed bandits
Niger.summary: The Nigerien army claims to have neutralized seven individuals described as "mercenaries" during operations on several fronts during the second half of October 2026. On October 20, near Amazguèr, in the north of the country, "two armed bandits were neutralized after opening fire on a patrol," according to the military toll reported by the Integrated Operations Coordination Center (CICO) .
